subject: general
question: What is the full form of SITAC launched by India and Sweden to deepen bilateral ties?

options.text: Sweden–India Technology and Artificial Intelligence Corridor

solution:
The correct answer is __**Sweden–India Technology and Artificial Intelligence Corridor.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **IndiaAI Mission and Business Sweden signed a Statement of Intent during the India AI Impact Summit 2026 to launch SITAC and enhance bilateral AI collaboration.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **SITAC stands for Sweden–India Technology and Artificial Intelligence Corridor.**
 
• It was launched as a flagship programme to promote structured and outcome-oriented AI cooperation.
 
• The initiative focuses on real-world industrial applications, innovation, and sustainable development.
 
• It promotes responsible AI deployment and strengthens bilateral digital partnerships.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **IndiaAI Mission:** A national initiative aimed at strengthening India’s artificial intelligence ecosystem through innovation, research, and industry collaboration.
 
• **Business Sweden:** The Swedish Trade and Invest Council that promotes Swedish exports and international partnerships.
 
• **Statement of Intent (SoI):** A formal declaration outlining mutual goals and cooperation frameworks between two entities.
 
• **India AI Impact Summit 2026:** A high-level platform focusing on AI-driven transformation, policy dialogue, and global collaboration.
